title: Acceleration calculation
description: Essential: The response must correctly compute the acceleration as 4 m/s² using the formula a = v/t for uniformly accelerated motion from rest.

title: Displacement during acceleration
description: Essential: The response must correctly compute the displacement during the acceleration phase as 8 m, using an appropriate kinematic formula.

title: Uniform motion time
description: Important: The response must correctly calculate the time for the constant-speed phase, requiring the use of the remaining distance and the constant velocity.

title: Total time summation
description: Important: The response must correctly sum the acceleration phase time and the constant-speed phase time to find the total time of 7.25 s.

title: Correct formula application
description: Important: The solution must demonstrate the correct selection and application of kinematic equations for uniformly accelerated and uniform motion.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All final answers should be presented with correct units (m/s², m, s).

title: Misusing distance for time
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses the total relay distance (50 m) as the distance for the acceleration phase only.

title: Sign or formula error
description: Pitfall: Penalize significant errors such as using v² = u² + 2as incorrectly for displacement or confusing average and final velocity.
